currentRunScope: Metadata, public official GetSign request and two-byte Range probe only. No application, installer, account session, service or driver was executed. Signed URLs and their values are not retained in this record. The Range probe is not a fresh full-artifact SHA-256 verification.

findings.recommended: Piko client download-layer resolver: sign the immutable official resource identity immediately before download; validate the exact HTTPS CDN host/path; keep the expected SHA-256 and existing bounds/cache/redirect policy.
findings.sourceOnlyAlternative: A self-managed stable HTTPS GET/HEAD endpoint can request an official signature and issue a no-store 302 to the exact official artifact. No payload mirroring required, but hosting and an extra availability/privacy dependency are introduced.
findings.catalogAction: Keep the verified durable 9.9.33.52230 package and manual policy until end-user downloads can resolve fresh signatures.
